name: @adhd/sox-extension-opencode-permission-audit
description: Use this skill when an opencode agent prompts for permission on every command, when a dispatched subagent's command fails with a permission error ('The user rejected permission…' or 'The user has specified a rule which prevents you from using this specific tool call'), or when you need to audit and repair an agent's permission.bash map. Ships two scanners: scripts/opencode-permission-scan.py (mines the opencode log and session DB for every permission ask, inferred answer, working directory, wasted time, deny catalog and auto-reject, plus a per-agent bash-map verdict with a drop-in corrected permission block. Includes the opencode inspection cheatsheet and the rules of permission resolution (merge order, last-match-wins, agent-map shadowing, atomic bash calls, non-interactive ask auto-reject).
author: sox-ecosystem
